'''Seaweed rolls''' were a food served on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Cilghal]] served some to [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], [[Tenel Ka Djo]] and [[Zekk]] when they visited the planet in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].
